name: Wrap The Zap
summary: Wrap The Zap is a sci-fi logic puzzle game centered on electrical conductivity and hexagonal grids. Players guide glowing electrical lines to connect colored conduits while adhering to the rule that lines cannot intersect. Gameplay mechanics involve using static and movable pins to bend paths around obstacles. The game offers multiple solutions per level across different sectors, featuring daily quests and a colorblind accessibility mode.
